issues.description: Wrong page is displayed. The current URL is /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-3b, meaning the user is being redirected to auth instead of reaching step-3b. The expected screen should show style blend confirmation with percentage bars (e.g. 65% Scandinavian, 35% Japandi), a 'This feels right' confirm button, and slider adjustment options. The auth page is blocking access to step-3b, likely because step-3b requires authentication and the user is not logged in.
issues.element: Entire page — showing auth gate instead of step-3b style blend confirmation
issues.root_cause: The /design/step-3b route has an authentication guard (middleware or page-level redirect) that is redirecting unauthenticated users to /auth?next=/design/step-3b. This is the auth wall working as intended, but for QA purposes the step-3b screen cannot be evaluated because the user session is not authenticated. The issue is either: (a) missing test session/auth bypass for QA, or (b) step-3b route is incorrectly requiring auth when it should be accessible, or (c) the QA runner is not authenticated.
